script: During the Cold War, American spy satellites kept photographing ordinary Soviet cargo trains, and nobody thought twice about them. That was exactly the point. Hidden inside those unremarkable green freight cars was a fully armed nuclear missile launcher, disguised to look identical to thousands of harmless trains crossing the Soviet rail network every single day. The missiles could roll into any station, launch within minutes, and vanish back into ordinary traffic before satellites ever refocused. American analysts spent years trying to tell the difference between a real threat and a train hauling potatoes. They never fully could. The Soviets had turned an entire railway system into an invisible nuclear arsenal, hiding devastating weapons in the most boring disguise imaginable.
